entry.title: dotnet/efcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-08-14
entry.content:
Issues

Updated

  • DB Scaffold Misnamed Navigation Properties ending in "Uuid" #38767
    Backlog
  • Many-to-many collection `ORDER BY` loses its only discriminating column (regression in 11.0) #38770
    11.0.0
  • GroupBy with an element selector prevents aggregates over reference navigations from being lifted into a join #38775
    Backlog
  • Query shaper assumes primitive collections are stored as JSON strings, breaking providers with native collection support (11.0 preview 7 regression) #38796
    11.0.0
  • Allow configuring SQLite synchronous mode in the connection string #38769
    Backlog
  • Microsoft.Data.Sqlite 10.0.11 breaks .NET Framework builds via SQLitePCLRaw.lib.e_sqlite3 2.1.12 missing win-arm native #38803
    10.0.13
  • [Regression 9.0 → 10.0] Query filter with inline array of navigation columns generates SQL referencing pruned columns #38700
    Backlog
  • Support for temporal tables for TPT (Table per Type) and other entity-splitting scenarios #26457
    Backlog

PullRequests

Created

  • Add SQLite synchronous connection string option #38812
    community-contribution, 12.0.0
  • Preserve discriminating ORDER BY for many-to-many collections #38811
  • Fix query shaping for native primitive collections #38810
  • Fix failing Cosmos tests #38808
  • [release/10.0] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #38807

Merged

  • Bump actions/upload-code-coverage from 1.4.1 to 1.4.2 #38809
    area-infrastructure
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/10.0' => 'main' #38768

Updated

  • fix: handle when WinRT APIs are unavailable #38612
    community-contribution, 12.0.0
  • Handle ranges spanning midnight when translating TimeOnly.IsBetween #38740
    community-contribution, 12.0.0
  • Discover the migrations-bundle DbContext out-of-process so publish doesn't lock the assembly #38456
    community-contribution, 12.0.0
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/8.0' => 'release/9.0' #38784
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/9.0' => 'release/10.0' #38785
